Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Faulkner
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 03/04/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 428 as introduced would exempt any sales through computer operated internet auctions from regulation by the State Board of Auctioneers, which are currently not regulated by practice of the board. This bill will not directly affect state or local funding.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions
